page_title: Vulert — Software Composition Analysis and Dependency Vulnerability Alerts

sources.entry: Vulert - Dependency vulnerability monitoring service for open-source packages.

summary.name: Vulert
summary.one_liner: Vulert is a software composition analysis (SCA) service that checks uploaded dependency manifests or SBOMs for known vulnerabilities and alerts you when new ones are disclosed.
use_cases: Find known vulnerabilities in application dependencies
Monitor open-source packages for newly disclosed CVEs
Check dependencies added by AI coding tools
Prepare vulnerability reports for security or compliance audits
Track risk across a portfolio of applications
summary.what_it_does: Users upload a supported dependency file or SBOM, and Vulert lists affected packages with severity, vulnerability background, and available fixes. Fix recommendations are tied to the specific major version the application uses. The service rechecks dependencies over time and alerts on newly disclosed vulnerabilities. It also offers an API and an MCP integration so coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor can scan dependency files and rescan after changes. No agent installation or source-code access is required.
notable: Version-specific fix guidance, so recommended upgrades match the version your app uses
No installation, agents, or source-code access needed; works from uploaded manifests or SBOMs
MCP integration lets coding agents scan dependencies and rescan after changes
Maintains vulnerability history and reports for audit and compliance reviews
caveats: Full report requires email verification; a 30-day free trial is offered, after which monthly pricing applies per monitored application
Supported dependency file and SBOM formats are listed on the page but not enumerated in the page text
Listed in awesome-mac, but the page describes a web service rather than a macOS app
